whatToWatch.text: Bounce-back at the Clink: Seattle's 2-1 and coming off a loss, laying 7 at home against a Chargers team giving up 25.3 points a game — this is the spot to remind everybody who the Hawks are.

Defense sets the tone: 16.7 points allowed per game and 2.3 sacks per game is legit, and it's on that group to carry the day with Julian Love and Brandon Pili among the names on the injury report (2 out, 3 questionable).
The number says grind: a 42.5 total means Vegas expects a low-scoring slugfest, and with both teams getting to the QB at the same 2.3 sacks-per-game clip, whoever wins the trenches walks out with it.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle limps home from Washington carrying a rare loss, one built on a stalled running game and three turnovers that handed the Commanders 21 points — exactly the sloppiness Mike Macdonald's group has to scrub before the Chargers arrive. The secondary could get reinforcements: Julian Love, sidelined by a calf injury suffered in practice, drew a "day to day" tag from Macdonald after encouraging Monday work. How the offense reestablishes the run will shape everything else in this one.
